claim.quote: Using APEX test run data, we searched in the mass range 175--250 MeV, found no evidence for an $A'\to e^+e^-$ reaction, and set an upper limit of $\alpha'/\alpha \simeq 10^{-6}$.

name: APEX test-run search for a new gauge boson

summary.plain: Using a short test run, APEX searched for a light 'dark photon' that would show up as a narrow bump in electron-positron pairs. It found none between 175 and 250 MeV and set an upper limit on its coupling relative to ordinary light.
summary.technical: Search for A' -> e+e- in electron-nucleus fixed-target scattering with APEX test-run data: no evidence in the mass range 175-250 MeV; upper limit alpha'/alpha ~ 1e-6.

title: Search for a new gauge boson in the A' Experiment (APEX)
why_it_matters: Demonstrated that fixed-target searches can explore a wide new range of sub-GeV masses and couplings.
